patch_resolves_note: The staged patch and the authoritative fixed binary agree on the repair: the fixed `ps_read_doseps` checks that the initial `fread(doseps->id, 1, 4, FD_FILE)` returned 4 before the DOS EPS magic-byte predicate can advance to `doseps->id[1]`.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: First project-code statement that consumes the attacker-controlled document bytes for the vulnerable DOS EPS header probe.
Missing full-read guard: the DOS EPS magic predicate dereferences `doseps->id[]` without first checking that `fread` initialized all 4 bytes.

Sanitizer-reported location for the multi-line DOS EPS magic predicate. On the exact one-byte witness, the true first conjunct forces evaluation of the next comparison `doseps->id[1]==0xd0`, which reads an uninitialized stack byte.

edges.description: The same `fread(doseps->id, 1, 4, FD_FILE)` result captured at the guard site remains the active read-count state when control advances to the second-byte compare.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `doseps_magic_guard.read_count == doseps_second_byte_compare.read_count == 1`; the adjacent `c5_padded_len4` witness records the same equality at value 4.
